devices.status.reconnecting: Lost contact with {name}. Retrying in {seconds} s …
devices.error.timeout: {name} did not answer. Check that it is switched on and close to the computer.
devices.error.not_found: Cannot find {name}. Check that it is switched on and close to the computer.
devices.error.no_bluetooth: Bluetooth is off or missing on this computer. Turn on Bluetooth in Windows and try again.
devices.error.no_treadmill_found: No Bluetooth treadmill found. Switch the treadmill on and try again.
devices.ftms.close_qz: Close QZ first: the treadmill accepts only one connection at a time.
devices.ftms.not_ftms: {name} cannot be controlled over Bluetooth (no FTMS).
devices.ftms.control_denied: The treadmill does not accept control right now. Press START on the treadmill and try again.
devices.ftms.command_failed: The treadmill did not accept the command ({what}).
devices.ftms.safety_key: The safety key is pulled. The treadmill has stopped.
devices.ftms.stopped_by_user: The treadmill was stopped on its console.
devices.hr.not_found: Cannot find {name}. Wet the electrodes and put the strap on to wake it.
devices.hr.none_found: No heart rate strap found. Wet the electrodes and put the strap on to wake it.
devices.hr.no_contact: The heart rate strap has no skin contact. Wet the electrodes and tighten the strap.
devices.hr.battery_low: The heart rate strap's battery is low ({pct} %). Replace it after the test.
devices.manual.name: Manual
devices.manual.status: The program tells you which speed and incline to set on the treadmill.
devices.qz.name: QZ
devices.qz.no_treadmill: QZ is running but has no treadmill connected. Connect the treadmill in QZ.
devices.qz.not_running: QZ is not running. Start QZ and connect the treadmill there, or choose Bluetooth (FTMS) to connect to the treadmill directly.
devices.qz.no_port: Cannot find QZ's port. Start QZ and turn on the web server in QZ's settings.
devices.qz.rejected: QZ did not accept the speed. Check that the treadmill is connected in QZ.
devices.qz.hr_needs_qz: Heart rate from QZ can only be used when the treadmill is controlled through QZ.
devices.bike.close_apps: Close Zwift, QZ and other training apps first, so that the program alone has the trainer.
devices.bike.not_ftms: {name} cannot be controlled over Bluetooth (no FTMS for cycling).
devices.bike.none_found: No trainer with Bluetooth found. Switch the trainer on and turn the pedals a few times to wake it.
devices.bike.no_erg: {name} says it cannot hold a set power (ERG). The test may have to be run manually.
devices.bike.control_denied: The trainer does not accept control right now. Close other apps connected to it and try again.
devices.bike.control_lost: The trainer took the control back. The program tries to take over again at the next stage.
devices.bike.command_failed: The trainer did not accept the command ({what}).
devices.pm5.not_pm5: {name} does not answer like a Concept2 PM5. Check that the monitor is a PM5 and that it is awake.
devices.pm5.none_found: No Concept2 PM5 found. Press a button on the monitor to wake it, and choose Connect in the monitor's menu.
devices.pm5.close_apps: Close ErgZone, ErgData and other apps connected to the monitor; it takes one app at a time.
devices.manual.status_bike: The program says which power the rider should hold.
devices.manual.status_skierg: The program says which power and pace the skier should hold.
devices.pm5.programmed: The test is on the monitor as a workout. Start pulling when the countdown on the TV ends.
devices.pm5.program_failed: The workout could not be put on the monitor. The test goes on with the target on the TV: choose Just Ski on the monitor.
